born.why: The code prioritizes survival by strictly avoiding fruits with any history of harm (poison), only consuming unproven fruits when hunger is high enough to justify the risk, and efficiently carrying proven safe fruits.

The code prioritizes survival by hard-avoiding any fruit species that has previously caused harm, overrides all caution during starvation, and uses a threshold-based approach to decide between tasting (low hunger), eating (high hunger/known good), and carrying (moderate hunger/known good) to optimize energy intake.

The code improves survival by using trait-based inference to guess safety of unknown fruits, avoids known poisons strictly, and manages energy by only interacting with food when hunger thresholds or trait-confidence justify the risk.

The code prioritizes starvation survival, then uses a weighted majority vote on past encounters to distinguish safe from poisonous species, avoiding repeated tasting of known good fruits by carrying them while strictly ignoring known poisons.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent, uses a "safe count" threshold to decide whether to carry fruit (reducing foraging risk), and avoids poisonous fruits unless forced by hunger, balancing caution with necessity.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding confirmed poisons and storing known-safe fruits, while using "taste" actions on unknown species only when hunger justifies the risk, effectively balancing immediate caloric needs against long-term information gathering.
